key_insight: Symmetric polyconvex neural networks (SPCNNs) guarantee symmetric polyconvexity by construction and universally approximate symmetric polyconvex energies without requiring isotropy.
engineering_relevance: SPCNNs offer a structure-preserving approach to small-strain constitutive modeling and approximation of symmetric polyconvex lower bounds for relaxed energies.
method: Combine convexity with the required monotonicity in a lifted space of minors.
Prove universal approximation and quantify attainable affine pieces.
Derive reduced architectures for isotropic energies.
evidence_signal: Numerical examples assess stress-based regression and approximation of the symmetric polyconvex envelope of a double-well potential.
watch_item: Structural guarantees do not ensure finite-network fitting accuracy, and a symmetric polyconvex envelope need not equal the full relaxed energy.
paper_title: Universal neural network approximation of symmetric polyconvex energies and envelopes
